svg.title: Repairing AGV paths after assignment
svg.desc: OrderAgvMovesAfterBlockingAgvs replays the DAG in topological order; if an AGV reposition is blocked only by another AGV's body, it gates the move on that AGV's next departure.
svg.metadata: ["AddNextMissingAgvMoveOrder() replays the DAG in topological order with exact AGV occupancy. At index k it reaches the AgvMove that sends AGV-1 from W25 to W8.", "Check 1: is AGV-1's path feasible when only AGV-1 itself is ignored? No: the path down past W13 is blocked, so OrderAgvMoveAfterBlockerDeparture() continues.", "Check 2: ignoring every other AGV the path is clear, so the obstacle is an AGV, not a tray or a disabled node.", "Check 3: try each other AGV X and ignore only {AGV-1, X}. With X = AGV-2 the path clears: AGV-2, parked on W13, is the blocker.", "Check 4: FindAgvDepartureFromNode(AGV-2, W13) looks after index k for the event in which AGV-2 leaves W13: AGV-2's AgvMove W13 -> P15 (dashed arrow).", "Check 5: AddDependency(departure, AGV-1's move), unless WouldCreateCycle() says it would form a cycle. AGV-1 now waits until AGV-2 has left W13.", "The pass returns true (one edge added) and OrderAgvMovesAfterBlockingAgvs starts a fresh replay. It stops when a full replay adds nothing, on an error, or after 256 passes.", "Playing the repaired order: AGV-2 departs first, driving from W13 into stall P15 under T15. W13 is now free.", "Only then AGV-1 drives its reposition W25 -> W22 -> W18 -> W13 -> W8, through the node AGV-2 has left."]

g.text: AssignAgvs orders events by its own serial assignment loop, which can differ from the final topological order. This pass replays the real order, where AGV occupancy is exact,

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: and adds one gating edge at a time. Trays and disabled nodes are not fixed here.
